summary.business_type: Personal brand / portfolio + bilingual technical blog (VI/EN)
top_findings: Internal prompt/brief files and img.png are publicly served from public/
datePublished is backdated on 54 series posts (owner decision to keep)
Most posts carry only 1 outbound source link
Homepage is indexable in English only; no hreflang
quick_wins: Export JPG OG images for the 5 /blog posts
Move PROMPTS/BRIEFS files and img.png out of public/
Fix footer label contrast and aria-label mismatches

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 77/77 sitemap URLs return 200; no broken internal links
Self-referencing canonicals on all pages; index, follow
308 redirects apex to www and http to https; real 404 status
robots.txt allows all bots, blocks /api/, references sitemap

findings.title: Internal files publicly served
findings.description: /images/blog/PROMPTS.md, PROMPTS.json, BRIEFS-v2.json, the same three under /images/blog/posts/, and /img.png all return 200.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: Only strict-transport-security is sent. No X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options/CSP frame-ancestors, Permissions-Policy.

findings.title: Homepage has no Vietnamese URL or hreflang
findings.description: / renders lang=en with a client-side language toggle; 76 other pages have vi/en/x-default.
findings.recommendation: Add /vi with hreflang, or accept EN-only indexing.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Median article length 1,156 words; shortest 948
First-hand examples, byline and dates on every post
No duplicate titles or descriptions

findings.title: Backdated datePublished
findings.description: 54 series posts are dated 2024-02-15 to 2026-11-12 while their URLs first went live this week. Owner chose to keep.
findings.recommendation: Use real publish dates; keep dateModified for edits.

findings.title: Few outbound source links
findings.description: Excluding profile and share links, posts have 0 to 4 outbound links; many series posts have exactly 1.
findings.recommendation: Add 3 to 5 links to official documentation per post.

findings.title: 3 outbound links redirect (301)
findings.description: AWS Builders' Library timeouts article, Express behind-proxies guide, Kubernetes probes page.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 0 titles over 60 characters; 0 descriptions over 160
Exactly one H1 per page
hreflang reciprocal on 76 pages; html lang matches

findings.title: /blog index overlaps /ai-for-devs index
findings.description: /blog lists all 31 posts including the 26 series posts. Post canonicals are correct, so no duplicate content.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: 0 JSON-LD parse errors across 77 pages
Person, WebSite, Blog, BlogPosting, BreadcrumbList present
BlogPosting has headline, dates, author, publisher, image, inLanguage, workTranslation

findings.title: Person schema exposes email and phone
findings.description: email and telephone are in the Person node on every page.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: CLS 0 on homepage and article
Homepage lab LCP 2.0 s (Slow 4G, 4x CPU)
Median TTFB 0.25 s; all pages prerendered with CDN cache HIT

findings.title: Article lab LCP 3.6 s on throttled mobile
findings.description: TTFB 563 ms, cover image load 3,007 ms, render delay 20 ms. Cover already has priority and sizes; the 828w variant is 40 KB. No CrUX field data.
findings.recommendation: Re-measure with field data; if p75 exceeds 2.5 s, cut competing font preloads and early JS.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended all receive 200
Lighthouse Agentic Browsing 100
Server-rendered HTML with clear heading structure and tables

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: /llms.txt returns 404. Optional; Google does not use it.

findings.title: Thin citations reduce citability
findings.description: See Content Quality: few outbound source links.
findings.recommendation: Cite primary sources next to claims.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 443 img tags, 100% with alt text
All images served through next/image as WebP with srcset
All 77 pages have og:image

findings.title: 10 /blog posts use a WebP og:image
findings.description: The 5 newest posts in both languages point og:image at .webp covers; the other 67 pages use JPG or generated PNG.
findings.recommendation: Export 1200x630 JPGs to public/images/blog/og/ and use them.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Export JPG OG images for the 5 /blog posts
Move PROMPTS/BRIEFS files and img.png out of public/

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Decide on a Vietnamese homepage URL with hreflang

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add 3 to 5 official source links per post
Fix footer contrast and aria-label mismatches

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Connect Search Console and submit the sitemap
Re-measure article LCP with CrUX field data
